stage0084_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Foolish creatures.
　Still they don't grasp
　their own powerlessness」

stage0084_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now, now.
　For humans, they wield
　considerable power」

stage0084_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「So humanity grew stronger
　while we lay sleeping」

stage0084_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Don't tell me... this is
　the Age of the Sun?」

stage0084_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「It's not impossible.
　In fact, the ring of fate is closing」

stage0084_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「All the more reason
　to crush them here」

stage0084_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That is our... a god's mission」

stage0084_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Heh heh... Resist with all your
　strength, humans. Offer that
　despair up to us」

stage0084_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$隼人$$
「So they saw our approach coming」

stage0084_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$キタン$$
「Bring it on!
　Then you know we've come here
　with our minds made up, right!」

stage0084_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Very well.
　We're sick of being chased around too」

stage0084_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「As you wish, we'll settle
　this here」

stage0084_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Though first, these two
　will serve as your opponents」

stage0084_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「In the name of the great King
　of the Underworld, Master $$ハーデス$$,
　arise, warriors of Mycenae!」

stage0084_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$安$$
「They've come back from hell, huh!
　Gloomy bunch」

stage0084_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Corpses revived by
　Lord $$ハーデス$$'s power.
　Their bodies brim with hatred for you」

stage0084_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Tremble in fear, humans!
　This is the power of
　the gods of Olympus!」

stage0084_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Once you're buried, we'll ravage the world,
　turn humanity's grief and curses to power,
　and make this planet our base against $$バアル$$!」

stage0084_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And then, for the battle
　to come against them...」

stage0084_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「A mere human, interrupting
　a god's words...!」

stage0084_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Who cares what you really are.
　What matters is you're our enemy」

stage0084_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「We won't let you do as you please
　with this world! That's why
　we're here!」

stage0084_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's enough of your gloating!
　Line up all the junk you want,
　we won't be scared!」

stage0084_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$タケル$$
「We've come here ready to die!
　To protect this planet's future!!」

stage0084_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Then come at me!
　Defeat this $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$,
　and I'll grant you that name!」

stage0084_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「The name of a hero, huh...
　Not bad」

stage0084_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$號$$
「Evolution that relies on power alone,
　forgetting the heart, has no future!
　You'll learn that!」

stage0084_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　We settle this with Mycenae, here!!」

stage0084_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Magnificent, humans...!
　I yield to you the name of hero!」

stage0084_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That was a hell of a finish, $$ガラダブラ$$」

stage0084_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$甲児$$
「The hero of Mycenae has fallen!
　Come out, $$ハーデス$$!!」

stage0084_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
???
「Don't you dare speak my name
　so freely, mere human!」

stage0084_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is $$ハーデス$$ causing this!?」

stage0084_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't misunderstand, humans.
　You are not who I've come to face」

stage0084_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Distortion in the dimensional boundary
　confirmed! Something's coming!」

stage0084_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アルト$$
「If something's coming,
　in this situation...!」

stage0084_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Come, then!
　Our sworn enemy, the hungry destroyer!!」

stage0084_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$渓$$
「You're saying they came
　to fight $$ハーデス$$!?」

stage0084_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Precisely, humans!
　In this battle of gods and demons
　across the galaxy, you mean nothing!」

stage0084_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$凱$$
「Th-those $$インベーダー#keyword$$ bastards
　are attacking!」

stage0084_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「They're clearly targeting us,
　not $$ハーデス$$!」

stage0084_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's not what $$ハーデス$$ said!」

stage0084_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nghh...! What is
　the meaning of this!?」

stage0084_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's rich, $$ハーデス$$!
　Seems like to the $$インベーダー#keyword$$,
　we're the more dangerous ones!」

stage0084_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Means the $$インベーダー#keyword$$ judged us
　stronger than you!」

stage0084_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Though I can't say
　I'm thrilled...」

stage0084_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$n
「And neither is the naked emperor,
　his pride bruised」

stage0084_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「A mere $$バアル$$, mocking me!
　Mocking the gods of Olympus!!」

stage0084_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Hmph...! Sounds like someone's
　lost their cool!」

stage0084_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But facing both a furious $$ハーデス$$
　and the $$インベーダー#keyword$$ at once...」

stage0084_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't chicken out over this, $$シンジ$$!
　You decided to protect the world,
　didn't you!」

stage0084_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カレン$$
「Sounds like someone's
　really lost it」

stage0084_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$宗介$$
「Losing one's temper so easily.
　Second-rate, as commander
　and soldier alike」

stage0084_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But facing both a furious $$ハーデス$$
　and the $$インベーダー#keyword$$ at once...」

stage0084_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't chicken out over this, $$シンジ$$!
　You decided to protect the world,
　didn't you!」

stage0084_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's right! We're here bearing
　the future of everyone in the world!!」

stage0084_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$甲児$$
「Be it the King of the Underworld
　or $$バアル$$, I won't let our future
　be shrouded in darkness!」

stage0084_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
???
「Precisely! Your future
　is filled with light!」

stage0084_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Your cry of courage crossed
　space and time. Guided by it,
　I descended to this place」

stage0084_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nghh! To manifest again
　in the material world!」

stage0084_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Acknowledge humanity's strength,
　$$ハーデス$$. This planet belongs
　to those born upon it」

stage0084_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Let us return to space,
　and prepare for the battle
　with $$バアル$$」

stage0084_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Silence, $$ゼウス$$!
　With this planet's $$オリジン・ロー$$,
　we might yet defeat them!」

stage0084_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$ハーデス$$! Have words lost
　all meaning to one possessed
　by power!」

stage0084_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Then let humans and gods join hands,
　and send you, fallen to a false god,
　back to the underworld!」

stage0084_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Are you ready for battle, warriors...
　no, heroes of steel!!」

stage0084_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$兜甲児$$! My light and your
　fighting spirit are about
　to become one!」

stage0084_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Power is welling up
　from Mazinger!!」

stage0084_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's right! That is the power
　of will that transcends even
　dimensions...! The power of light!!」

stage0084_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ボス$$
「Wh-whoa! That's even more
　power than before!!」

stage0084_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$安$$
「Heh...! A giant god of light
　and a demon god of light, huh!」

stage0084_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Our enemies are the King of the Underworld
　and the hungry destroyer!
　No shortage of worthy opponents!」

stage0084_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah...! We absolutely
　can't lose this fight!」

stage0084_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do it, for the future!」

stage0084_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nuoooh!! You humans! You, $$ゼウス$$!!
　You've truly angered me now!!」

stage0084_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「As long as that arrogance remains,
　you are unworthy of the name
　of god!!」

stage0084_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here we come, $$ハーデス$$!
　Our light will banish
　your darkness!!」

stage0084_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Damn you...! Damn youuuu!!
　How dare you...!」

stage0084_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Humans, you will regret this!
　With your power, you cannot break
　the Prison of Time!」

stage0084_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Even if you did break it,
　what awaits is $$バアル$$'s onslaught!
　And then, they'll come too!」

stage0084_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That's not all! A fundamental
　calamity will strike you all,
　eventually!」

stage0084_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「As I thought, you understand nothing!
　You'll never cross the 12,000-year
　wheel of rebirth like that!」

stage0084_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Answer me, $$ハーデス$$!
　What is this 12,000-year wheel!?」

stage0084_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That's the cycle of the universe's rebirth!
　Then $$バアル$$ swarms to erase the universe's
　life... its spirit particles!」

stage0084_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Th-the thing being reborn
　isn't people...」

stage0084_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バアル$$'s... the space monsters'
　appearance, that's the reason!?」

stage0084_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You will perish before you ever
　touch that truth! Before you climb
　the stairway to godhood!」

stage0084_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Silence, false god!
　I deny anyone who uses power
　to cast others aside, as you do!」

stage0084_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$甲児$$
「If that's what you call a god,
　then we'll become the power
　to strike that god down!!」

stage0084_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Foolish, you humans!
　Gods are eternal! Gods are undying!!
　Immortality is the power of a god!!」

stage0084_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Someday, I shall rise again!
　With the power of the underworld!!」

stage0084_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$甲児$$
「You just don't know when to quit!!」

stage0084_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's the end of $$ハーデス$$...」

stage0084_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$號$$
「One battle has come to an end...」

stage0084_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$ハーデス$$ and the gods of Olympus have fallen」

stage0084_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$凱$$
「B-but... he said something ominous
　right at the end!」

stage0084_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$弁慶$$
「That's just a dying man's bluff.
　No need to pay it any mind」

stage0084_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$渓$$
「More important is the 12,000-year
　ring of fate」

stage0084_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The whole universe is reborn...
　The mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ is a sign of it...」

stage0084_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Then what happens to our universe!?」

stage0084_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Being reborn means...
　does that mean we die before that...」

stage0084_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「The universe is going to die...!?」

stage0084_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Could something like that really happen...」

stage0084_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$シン$$
「That's got to be a bluff too.
　If it wasn't, this universe would
　have been born 12,000 years ago」

stage0084_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「True, no such fact has ever
　been observed」

stage0084_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's something you must
　find out for yourselves」

stage0084_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$甲児$$
「We just beat a god.
　Wouldn't look good to start
　praying to one now」

stage0084_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's the spirit...
　you heroes of steel.........」

stage0084_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「It seems my time left
　in this world has reached
　its limit.........」

stage0084_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「You and I are comrades of light.........
　Someday, we'll meet again
　beyond the horizon of causality.........」

stage0084_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「And so, in gratitude to you
　for setting my brethren right,
　I shall open the path of light.........」

stage0084_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Heroes of steel...
　save the future of both worlds.........」

stage0084_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$n
「The path of light $$ゼウス$$
　spoke of at the end...」

stage0084_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$田中司令$$
「An extremely unstable point on the
　dimensional boundary has been observed
　above this area」

stage0084_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$田中司令$$
「This is... exactly the same as the
　dimensional gate that appears
　when the Altairan army shows up」

stage0084_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「If you claim to have inherited
　$$ゼウス$$'s soul, then show me
　that power!」

stage0084_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it!
　Guess that hero name isn't
　just for show after all!」

stage0084_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$甲児$$
「But!
　If I can't beat you, there's no way
　I can beat $$ハーデス$$ either!」

stage0084_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm getting past you, $$ガラダブラ$$!
　We're fighting $$ハーデス$$ to
　protect this world!!」

stage0084_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You who wield Getter rays!
　No human can control that power!」

stage0084_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Sorry, Hero Skeleton!
　I don't give a damn
　about Getter rays!」

stage0084_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Getter Robo is power to crush
　the enemy! I'm taking your
　'hero' title!!」

stage0084_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You brat!
　I'll give you this much credit,
　challenging the King of the Underworld!」

stage0084_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm not fighting for
　words like that!
　I'm fighting to beat you!」

stage0084_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You make me laugh!
　I've no time for a child's nonsense!」

stage0084_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You jerk!
　If you lose to this kid,
　quit calling yourself a god!」

stage0084_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I really hate guys who sit
　there acting all high and mighty!!」

stage0084_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So you're Mars, the one
　who defeated Emperor $$ズール$$!」

stage0084_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Why do you know about $$ズール$$!?」

stage0084_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Dark power gathers into one...!
　He and I share the same source!」

stage0084_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Flames of darkness...!
　This power... it's dangerous!」

stage0084_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Mars!
　Die before you learn why
　you and your brother were born!」

stage0084_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$タケル$$
「The meaning of why my brother
　and I were born...!?」

stage0084_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Die, Mars!
　Fall into the world of darkness
　along with your brother!」

stage0084_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$タケル$$
「Not a chance, $$ハーデス$$!
　I promised my brother I'd fight
　for the universe's peace and future!」

stage0084_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'll unleash all of
　my psychic power!
　$$ハーデス$$! Go back to the world of darkness!!」

stage0084_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I see!
　This puppet that houses the sun
　truly opposes the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!!」

stage0084_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you talking about the
　Solar Energy Conversion Device!」

stage0084_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That power is a nuisance
　even to me! I'll finish off
　whoever bears the sun's light myself!」

stage0084_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Not a chance!
　$$鉄人$$ is the power of justice
　my father left me, to protect peace!」

stage0084_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　Drive away $$ハーデス$$'s darkness
　with your solar power!!」

stage0084_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I see...!
　So you too were gathered
　into this world!」

stage0084_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「But even your existence,
　which transcends causality, is
　powerless before a god! I'll show you!」

stage0084_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Then let me teach you
　something too」

stage0084_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I bow to no one's rule.
　Not even a god's」

stage0084_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Found you, true singularity!
　I'll make good use of your power!」

stage0084_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$桂$$
「That's a passionate approach,
　but no thanks when it's some
　tough-looking old geezer」

stage0084_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$桂$$
「Though with an attitude as
　condescending as yours, I'd refuse
　even if you were a beautiful woman!」

stage0084_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$桂$$
「This $$桂木桂$$ is a man who
　loves beautiful women and freedom!
　Brutes like you piss me off most!!」

stage0084_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one too bears the sun's
　budding light within!」

stage0084_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy... what's he
　talking about!?」

stage0084_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I'll tell you one thing!
　Being struck down here is a mercy!
　Survive, and you'll surely regret it!」

stage0084_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What meaning is there in
　a life someone else decides!」

stage0084_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「King of the Underworld, $$ハーデス$$!
　Don't think you can bend
　humanity to your will!!」

stage0084_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So this man is the forerunner!」

stage0084_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Evolution is not permitted
　to humanity! That is the
　judgment of the gods!」

stage0084_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「As if I'd let something like you
　decide what humanity should be!」

stage0084_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We believe in humanity's future!
　If something stands in the way
　of that path, I will fight it!」

stage0084_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Humanity has no future!
　That is the will of the gods!」

stage0084_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Too afraid to even speak!
　Then die!!」

stage0084_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You have no right to
　decide our future」

stage0084_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Enemy of humanity, Mycenae.
　I will eliminate you...!」

stage0084_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$シン$$
「Do you understand that each
　human you treat like vermin
　has a life of their own!」

stage0084_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Such a thing means nothing
　before the will of the gods!」

stage0084_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Understand this, humans!
　In this universe, your existence
　is no different from a single bug!」

stage0084_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$シン$$
「Each of those humans has a life,
　has joys and sorrows,
　and is living for all they're worth!」

stage0084_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$シン$$
「Someone who calls that
　meaningless is no god!!」

stage0084_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The law of the universe is
　survival of the fittest!
　Humanity's fate is to be culled!」

stage0084_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$キラ$$
「By gaining power, it seems
　you forgot something important...」

stage0084_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$キラ$$
「I won't accept people like you
　who've forgotten love and kindness...!」

stage0084_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$キラ$$
「Power alone can't make
　a person happy! I'll fight you
　for not understanding that!!」

stage0084_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$刹那$$
「One who rejects others,
　forcing their desires through
　with power...!」

stage0084_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That is the law of the universe!
　Battle is the universe's truth!
　Only ruin awaits those who defy it!」

stage0084_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$刹那$$
「I won't accept
　anything like that!」

stage0084_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$刹那$$
「A world where fighting
　never ends must not exist!!」

stage0084_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Fear the gods, humanity!
　And regret your own powerlessness!」

stage0084_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You people... aren't
　gods at all...!」

stage0084_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Such delusions!
　Has fear broken your mind!」

stage0084_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans possess a god...
　A god called possibility...」

stage0084_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Possibility is an infinite future!
　One who'd steal that is no god!」

stage0084_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The blood of beasts
　ends here! Die, little girl!」

stage0084_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$葵$$
「Sorry, but our blazing blood
　won't be cooled by threats like that!」

stage0084_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This fighting spirit...!
　Just as I thought, these ones are...!」

stage0084_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$葵$$
「Too late to say stop now!
　Our fighting spirit's already
　in the red zone!」

stage0084_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$葵$$
「Here we go, $$ハーデス$$!!
　Let's do this!!」

stage0084_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I don't know if you're a god
　or what, but liiisten to my song!!」

stage0084_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one...!
　Don't tell me, the legendary
　《$$アニマスピリチア$$》!」

stage0084_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't go spouting 《$$ゲペルニッチ$$》
　nonsense! More than that,
　layer your soul onto my sound!!」

stage0084_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nguh...!
　Even a man like this, gathered here...
　just what is happening on this planet!」

stage0084_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nguh...!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0084_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Wrong guy, old geezer!
　Or are you still half-asleep!」

stage0084_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So you still haven't awakened to your true purpose!
　Then victory is still within my grasp!」

stage0084_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's awfully gracious of you!
　Pretty humble for a self-proclaimed god!」

stage0084_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But it's too late now!
　We're already fired up!」

stage0084_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You picked a fight with humanity and me!
　Don't think you'll get off easy!!」

stage0084_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Child of Getter rays!
　What do you intend to do on this planet!?」

stage0084_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$號$$
「I'm just watching over where humanity is headed.
　It's each and every person who decides that path.」

stage0084_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Spare me the pretty words!
　I'll erase you before you show your true nature!」

stage0084_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$號$$
「I'll tell you this, gods of Olympus...!
　Whoever crushes humanity's potential is my enemy!」

stage0084_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$號$$
「Let's do this, Getter!!
　We're protecting Earth's future!!」

stage0084_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's a fight between an office worker and a god!
　Let's go all out!!」

stage0084_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「How pitiful!
　Mustering the last of your courage to face me!」

stage0084_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$赤木$$
「What's wrong with that!?
　Every human you call a mere bug
　is living with all their might!」

stage0084_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$赤木$$
「To protect that,
　god or devil, whoever I face,
　I'll fight with my life on the line!!」

stage0084_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's the fight $$ダイ・ガード$$ and I are waging!!」

stage0084_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's no way to ask someone something.
　Gods, it seems, know nothing of manners.」

stage0084_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「A god showing courtesy to mere humans? Unthinkable!」

stage0084_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「As long as you cling to that arrogance,
　we're unlikely to become friends.」

stage0084_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　Don't think mere humans are our equals!」

stage0084_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even after seeing the bond between $$ゼウス$$ and $$甲児$$,
　you still say that. You disappoint me, $$ハーデス$$.」

stage0084_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just as I thought, you don't deserve godhood...!
　At the least, you're nothing like
　the god carved into this $$ビッグオー$$!」

stage0084_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「So that's it, I see...!
　What you're riding is...」

stage0084_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The time for talk is already over...!
　From here, we'll play by your rules!」

stage0084_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now you'll learn!
　The power of $$ビッグオー$$, built in the name of a god!!」

stage0084_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You're mistaken about what a god's power means.」

stage0084_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Mere humans, speaking as if they understand!」

stage0084_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even if I myself am heir to a god's existence?」

stage0084_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「What!?
　A god's secret art was left behind in this world!?」

stage0084_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Humanity has no need for such a thing!
　I deny the gods!」

stage0084_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「We seek the future!
　I won't kneel to gods who lost their future
　in the name of eternity!!」

stage0084_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Come then, human!
　I'll teach you just how powerless you are!」

stage0084_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Struck speechless with fear!
　Not that I blame you!」

stage0084_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$宗介$$
「You may indeed be a god...」

stage0084_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「But as a soldier, you're second-rate.」

stage0084_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Anyone who puts on airs on a battlefield dies early!
　Learn that the hard way.」

stage0084_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Speaking that way to this undying god...」

stage0084_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The Wings...!?
　No, this is a wing dog!」

stage0084_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「In the end, a wing dog is a wing dog!
　Those frail wings won't get you far against a god!」

stage0084_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm... not the wing dog Polon!
　I'm human, $$アマタ・ソラ$$!」

stage0084_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And these wings of mine...!
　are wings that soar past enemies, sorrow, and fate!」

stage0084_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld!
　My wings will soar past your darkness too!!」

stage0084_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one...!
　A survivor of the civilization of fire!」

stage0084_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't underestimate me!
　Even alone, $$ガンバスター$$
　still holds a flame inside it!」

stage0084_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「My own flame...!
　And the flame entrusted to me by Big Sis!
　That's what burns as $$ガンバスター$$'s fire!」

stage0084_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Very well, human!
　Show me the power you honed fighting $$バアル$$!」

stage0084_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「An evil god shrouding Earth's future in darkness...!
　I will never give up!」

stage0084_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「With this $$ガンバスター$$,
　I will definitely smash your wicked ambitions!!」

stage0084_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Man of the Spiral!
　Know that the wind's destination is ruin!」

stage0084_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't think saying 'ruin' or 'annihilation'
　will shut us up!!」

stage0084_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$シモン$$
「If something's holding me down, I drill through it!
　If there's a wall in front of me, I drill through it!
　That's my drill!」

stage0084_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「No wonder the Anti-Spirals are on the move!
　This one's Spiral already surges toward the heavens!」

stage0084_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$シモン$$
「It's too late for regrets, $$ハーデス$$!
　You made an enemy of me, don't expect it easy!!」

stage0084_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You human...!
　Using this one as a vessel to walk the path to godhood!」

stage0084_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What on earth are they talking about...!?」

stage0084_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I'll crush you before the time comes!
　A human becoming a god is not something I'll allow!」

stage0084_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I-I don't really get what they're saying, but...!」

stage0084_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm a member of $c too!
　Even against a god, I'll fight alongside everyone!!」

stage0084_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The bearer of a fragment of Taiji...!?
　No, that's not it!」

stage0084_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「But I can certainly feel it...
　A trace of their power...!」

stage0084_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Just what is this one...!?」

stage0084_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$n
「I'll say the same right back at you, $$ハーデス$$!
　What exactly are you!?」

stage0084_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$n
「The god I know isn't some ugly pig
　drowning in naked greed like you.」

stage0084_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$n
「Falling for such a cheap taunt shows
　just how low a god's level really is!」

stage0084_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$n
「Good timing!
　Before I settle things with the Angel,
　I'll crush this self-proclaimed god!!」

stage0084_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Stop this fight, $$ハーデス$$!
　Our mission is to watch over those who follow us!」

stage0084_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Wrong, $$ゼウス$$!
　A god is a being that rules over all,
　and one permitted to do so!」

stage0084_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「And indeed, that's how they behave!
　In the name of a god's messenger!」

stage0084_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Are you saying you'll go along with that too!」

stage0084_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Go along with it?
　Don't talk nonsense, $$ゼウス$$!
　Our true purpose is to win the war of the gods!」

stage0084_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「And for that, this planet, brimming with $$オリジン・ロー$$,
　is indispensable to our strength!」

stage0084_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「If that means you'll take human lives for it...!」

stage0084_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Then as a god, I will strike you down!
　Together with the strong-hearted heroes of steel!!」

stage0084_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「R-ridiculous!
　You're facing $$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld!」

stage0084_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I-incredible!
　Is this the shape of evolution humanity has reached!?」

stage0084_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Then I'll face you with all my power!
　A god losing to a human...
　no, to an animal, must never happen!」

stage0084_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You irritating little bug!
　I'll tear those wings right off!」

stage0084_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「Try it if you can!
　I won't let someone like you steal my hope!」

stage0084_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This one...!
　To feel no fear at all before me,
　$$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld!」

stage0084_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$アルト$$
「Hell or the underworld, I'll still fly!
　For the sake of what I have to protect!!」

stage0084_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Successor to $$ゼウス$$!
　I'll repay the debt from the age of myths!」

stage0084_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Still clinging to the past, how small of you,
　$$ハーデス$$!」

stage0084_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「You...!
　Do you mean to mock the gods!?」

stage0084_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up!
　You trample on life, how could you be gods!」

stage0084_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll show you!
　The power of humans you call mere bugs...!
　The power of one who believes in hope!」

stage0084_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$甲児$$
「And the power of Mazinger, filled with light!!」

stage0084_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「T-this one...!
　Transcending humanity, becoming a demon god!?」

stage0084_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$! Return to the darkness of the underworld!!」
